newsitem.title: USA: EchoStar unit issues $375 million debt.
newsitem.headline: EchoStar unit issues $375 million debt.

text.p: The following 144a debt issue from EchoStar DBS Corp, a wholly-owned subsidiary of EchoStar Communications Corp, was priced Friday via lead manager Donaldson Lufkin and Jenrette, according to market sources.

Proceeds of the issue will be used to fund the satellite escrow account for the EchoStar IV satellite, set to be launched in the first quarter of 1998, and costs related to the EchoStar III satellite, to be launched this September.
A total of $109 million from the issue will fund the first five semi-annual interest payments on the notes.
The issue was increased in size by $50 million.
